cases.expect: transport replay uses byte-identical request and observationId
successful reset clears locally acknowledged observation IDs so the ID can be reused
snapshot revisions at or below the accepted revision are suppressed
reconnect uses lastSnapshotRevision equal to the last accepted revision
close cancels reconnect delay and prevents queued requests or events
HTTP response and WebSocket message bodies above maxMessageBytes fail before decode
reset and delete are not replayed after ambiguous transport failure
